An '''astronomical object''' of blue [[Color/Legends|color]] was to be found in the [[Bith system/Legends|Bith system]].<ref name="Rising" /> It was home to members of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Shakedown" /> who were native to [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] despite sharing a name with the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="EGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was positioned next to it during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Rising" />
